pages.text: The total filling power of your dishes decides how many guests you can attract. The variety and quality of those dishes decide whether a rare guest will come at all, and how good a gift she will leave behind.$(br2)Dishes with higher saturation count for more appeal, and the same dish only ever counts once.

Every guest has her own threshold. A single cake is enough to invite Cirno, while Suika wants a grand buffet.$(br2)You can put out more food partway through, but a guest who has already eaten her fill slows down sharply, and may leave early.

Reputation does not decide whether a guest comes, only how much likelier she is to come: someone you know well is nearly twice as willing as a stranger.$(br2)Afterwards every guest leaves a gift, and how good it is depends on the appeal of the food she ate.
